final_response:
I wouldn’t count on 6:45 AM. She needs to be inside her corral by **7:00 AM**, leaving only **10 minutes for security** plus the five-minute walk.

A [past Gate D report](race-info/runner-report-b.md) describes a roughly **35-minute security wait at 6:40 AM**. That’s from 2023, so it doesn’t establish this year’s wait, but it makes 6:45 a risky choice. I’d stick with the [official 6:15 AM arrival recommendation](race-info/official-schedule.md).
